sections.heading: Step 1 · I Do — Teacher Teaches Grade 4

a.label: Grade 4
a.body: Read and write 5-digit whole numbers (up to 100 000) in a place-value chart, expanded form, and words.

b.label: Grade 5
b.body: Read and write 6-digit whole numbers (up to 1 000 000) in a place-value chart, expanded form, and words.

sections.heading: Step 1 · I Do — Teacher Teaches Grade 5

a.label: Grade 4
a.body: Read and write 5-digit whole numbers (up to 100 000) in a place-value chart, expanded form, and words.

b.label: Grade 5
b.body: Read and write 6-digit whole numbers (up to 1 000 000) in a place-value chart, expanded form, and words.

items.q: Bazaar mein sab se bari qeemat kya dekhi hai?
Chaand kitna door hai — 363 104 ko kaise parhenge?

items.label: Step 1
items.body: Amina sees a price board in the bazaar.

items.label: Step 2
items.body: She reads it digit by digit: seven, eight, five, zero, zero.

items.label: Step 3
items.body: Her father puts each digit in its own place.

items.label: Step 4
items.body: Now she reads it: seventy-eight thousand and five hundred rupees.

items.label: Step 1
items.body: Bilal finds a number in the newspaper.

items.label: Step 2
items.body: 391 000 kinds of plants grow in the world.

items.label: Step 3
items.body: He counts three digits from the right and leaves a space.

items.q: Amina ne pehle galat kyun parha?
Teen digit ke baad space kyun chhodte hain?

sections.heading: Each Step Is Ten Times Bigger
sections.body: Move one place to the left and the value grows ten times: 1 → 10 → 100 → 1,000 → 10,000 → 100,000.

sections.heading: One Bundle For Every Place
sections.body: Zero-cost materials: sticks, paper squares, pebbles represent 1, 10, 100, 1 000, 10 000, 100 000.

sections.heading: Leave A Space Every Three Digits
sections.body: 363104 is hard to read; 363 104 is easy to read = three hundred and sixty-three thousand, one hundred and four.

a.label: Grade 4
a.body: Fill chart for 69 273. 69 273 = 60 000 + 9 000 + 200 + 70 + 3. Say: sixty-nine thousand, two hundred and seventy-three.

a.label: Grade 4
a.body: Write in expanded form: 75 432 · 37 911 · 10 956 · 46 743 (Mathematics 4, Exercise 1, page 5)

b.label: Grade 5
b.body: Fill chart for 456 907. 456 907 = 400 000 + 50 000 + 6 000 + 900 + 7. Say: four hundred and fifty-six thousand, nine hundred and seven.

b.label: Grade 5
b.body: Add one more card and make a 6-digit number.

a.label: Grade 4
a.body: Write in words: 74 325 · 43 711 · 19 560 · 75 434 (Mathematics 4, Exercise 1, page 5, Q4)

b.label: Grade 5
b.body: Write in expanded form: 131 441 · 600 900 (Mathematics 5, Exercise 1, page5, Q2)

sections.heading: Teacher Rotation
sections.body: 2 min with Grade 4 <-> 2 min with Grade 5. Never more than 3 minutes with one class.

a.label: Grade 4
a.body: Today we read and wrote 5-digit numbers up to 100 000 — in the chart, in expanded form, and in words.

b.label: Grade 5
b.body: Today we read and wrote 6-digit numbers up to 1 000 000 — in the chart, in expanded form, and in words.

items.q: Write 62 897 in words. Is the 6 worth 6 or 60 000? How do you know?
items.a: 60 000, because it sits in the Ten Thousands place.

items.q: Write 242 140 in words. The digit 2 appears twice. Is it worth the same both times? Why?
items.a: No — one is worth 200 000 and the other 2 000.

a.label: Grade 4
a.body: Mathematics 4, Exercise 1, page 5, Q4 (e) to (h): write 67 459, 25 302, 36 721 and 78 065 in words.

b.label: Grade 5
b.body: Mathematics 5, Exercise 1, page 5, Q2 (c) to (f): write 949 181, 466 456, 286 019 and 479 321 in expanded form.
